name: Perplexity SPACE
description: Runs agent and user code in isolated Firecracker microVM sandboxes on your own infrastructure, with an HTTP API to create sandboxes and stream command output.

skills.name: Sandbox Lifecycle
skills.description: Creates sandboxes from templates and pauses, suspends, wakes or deletes them through asynchronous operations you poll.

skills.name: Command Execution
skills.description: Starts processes in a sandbox and streams their output and exit result over server-sent events with a session token.

skills.name: E2B Compatibility
skills.description: Lets an existing E2B Python SDK client run against SPACE through the E2B Compatibility Wrapper and its own API keys.

skills.name: Warm Pools
skills.description: Keeps pools of booted sandboxes ready on Kubernetes so new sandbox creates skip a cold boot and start faster.
